name: uma
description: Persistent, evidence-backed memory for Codex. Cross-session recall via the local uma-mcp server, plus health checks and automatic turn capture.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed memory layer for AI coding workflows
interface.longDescription: UMA adds persistent, evidence-backed memory to Codex via a local uma-mcp server. Curated context and compiled memory are retrieved with provenance, and each session's last exchange is captured automatically so Codex keeps continuity across restarts.
